payload.text: (hv, 2026-11-17, by selection in the TUI in vc's session, answered by 11:22Z on vc's date -u; the options' wording vc's, the choice hv's and vc's recommendation) THE RELEASE IS 3.4.0, a minor. Issue 0700 adds a verb, intent claude rules contract, and reshapes the six critic subagents every project installs to read their contract through it, which is new surface under hv's patch-vs-minor rule; the rest of the release (0696, 0697, 0698, 0699, 0701) are fixes. vc's earlier suggestion of 3.3.4 was made before 0700 was in scope.
